page_title: MCI 4-0 NEW | Manchester City v Newcastle 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Alexander Isak cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' That's the end of the game for Erling Haaland, who is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
87' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josko Gvardiol departs the field of play to be replaced by Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City).
87' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' 4 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and James McAtee (Manchester City) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Erling Haaland knock down. 4:0.
84' Corner kick. Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) is ready to send the ball into the box.

83' Savinho (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.

82' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball forward to Valentino Livramento, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.

80' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Andy Madley blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to Newcastle.
76' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. James McAtee (Manchester City) replaces Phil Foden.
76' Substitution. Omar Marmoush is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
73' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) replacing Anthony Gordon.
72' Substitution. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) on for Bruno Guimaraes.
72' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) got into an offside position. It was tight, but it's not the first time he got caught today.
71' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to find Omar Marmoush, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
70' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
67' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
66' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester City.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:3. The shots on goal statistics – 6:1.
61' The corner by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

60' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Ederson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
59' Phil Foden (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

56' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
56' Phil Foden (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.
55' Savinho (Manchester City) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Martin Dubravka is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
53' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
52' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Now Newcastle have a corner.
52' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The game is over for Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd). Lewis Miley comes on for the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is replaced by Valentino Livramento.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Manchester City are taking a throw-in.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' The corner kick picks out Erling Haaland (Manchester City) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
41' The referee awards a corner and Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take it.
39' Kieran Trippier sends a terrific cross into the box. Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just over the bar.
39' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.
37' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
36' The ball is cleared after Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
33' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Savinho tees up Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) inside the box and he slams the ball past Martin Dubravka.
32' Andy Madley blows his whistle and it's Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

30' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
29' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

29' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempts to find Phil Foden with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
28' Savinho (Manchester City) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Martin Dubravka.
28' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
26' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is unmarked in the penalty area and heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper stops his attempt by pulling off a fine save.

24' 2 - 0 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) neatly controls a decent pass from Ilkay Gundogan. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 2:0.
22' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Alexander Isak with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Ederson finds Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 1:0.
17' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Erling Haaland, but Martin Dubravka displays great awareness to stop him.
17' 11:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
16' Josko Gvardiol plays a lovely pass into Omar Marmoush (Manchester City), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
16' Phil Foden (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' Savinho (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
9' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
8' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' The resulting corner, taken by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City), comes to nothing.

5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball forward to Kieran Trippier, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
4' Referee Andy Madley sees the trip by Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Newcastle will take a free kick.
2' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' The first half has started.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
